name: Smash Up Derby
summary:
Smash up Derby is a racing game with destructive racing similar to the Destruction Derby games. The player becomes a driver taking part in breakneck races and by triumphing in subsequent competitions can climb the career ladder. Just like in Destruction Derby, the aim of is not only to get to the finish line first, but also to "smash" other opponents, damage their cars etc.

Players can smash up 20 different computer controlled cars on 28 tracks. Multiplayer is supported for up to eight players via LAN or internet.
